# aura-components-mcp

> Current source branch: 35 MCP tools, package metadata prepared as 2.0.0 but not yet published. npm latest was verified as 1.7.3 on 2026-11-23. Zero npm runtime dependencies; Node >=22. The Aura catalogue and credited content belong to Aura and its authors. This is an independent project.

- Repo: https://github.com/swastiksingh-dev/Aura-Components-MCP
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-components-mcp
- Setup: https://github.com/swastiksingh-dev/Aura-Components-MCP/blob/main/SETUP.md
- Tool contract catalogue: `docs/v2/TOOL_CONTRACTS.md`
- Design Contract: `docs/v2/DESIGN_CONTRACT.md`
- Research evidence limits: `docs/v2/RESEARCH_LIBRARY.md`
- Motion/responsive evidence limits: `docs/v2/MOTION_RESPONSIVE.md`
- Official Aura MCP (account projects/publishing, OAuth): https://www.aura.build/mcp

## Start here

- Call `aura_status`, then `aura_search_all` or a surface-specific search.
- Use `aura_plan_design` for a bounded Design Contract. It separates supplied facts, heuristics/recommendations, and open questions; it is not a design model or user study.
- Discovery is metadata-first. Search defaults to five results; continue with `offset` / `next_offset`. Detail tools omit large source unless passed `chunk` or `full:true`.
- `aura_bundle` and `aura_scaffold_page` return metadata/source pointers by default. Source retrieval is bounded and chunkable.
- `aura_diff` compares 2–4 free components using known record facts. Unavailable bundle size, runtime performance, visual quality, and compatibility remain unknown.
- `aura_research_search` and `aura_research_read` use a small curated local seed, not a live research index. Claims link to stored provenance and limitations; no paper/PDF content is returned.
- `aura_motion_plan` returns planning recommendations, not observations unless a caller supplies an explicitly unverified summary.
- `aura_docs_plan` and `aura_docs_check` are pure helpers; the agent performs any Context7 lookup.
- `aura_icon` returns an SVG and required credit. `aura_version` checks npm; `aura_status` includes its verdict.
- Award intelligence: `aura_award_search`, `aura_award_inspect`, `aura_design_blueprint`, `aura_visual_audit`, `aura_motion_study`, `aura_award_index`.

## Tool surface

The current source registry has 35 tools. See `docs/v2/tool-definitions.json` for exact schemas. The five `aura_inspo_*` mapping tools from the older v1 surface are retired; use catalogue search, award tools, `aura_diff`, or `aura_scaffold_page`.

## Browser and evidence limits

- Chrome/Chromium is optional; it is needed for browser screenshots, live DOM geometry, responsive matrices, and runtime motion inspection. Without it, browser-required operations report unavailability; ordinary catalogue/design/research use remains available.
- ffmpeg is optional and only needed to encode `.webm` motion recordings. `record` is a bounded scroll tour, not named click/hover/focus capture.
- Responsive checks measure up to seven viewport widths and report candidate bounds. They are not a full accessibility audit; late content can shift after the short settle.
- Static HTML structure is an estimate without measured offsets. Reference comparison is not pixel/perceptual parity.
- REA is a separate optional tool and is neither installed nor required by Aura.

## Safety, licensing, and retrieval

- Component and asset access is fail-closed: only records with `premium:false` are returned by protected paths.
- No-match and upstream failure are distinct. Do not treat unavailable metrics as negative facts.
- Chunk responses expose length/truncation information. Fetch subsequent chunks with the same detail tool and requested `chunk`.
- Asset licensing: Aura Terms §4 describe assets as all-rights-reserved; check source terms and obtain permission before commercial reuse. Free catalogue access is not a commercial license.
- Icon attribution returned by `aura_icon` must be retained.
- Research is local and curated; metadata date does not imply ongoing correction/retraction monitoring. Closed-access sources are metadata-only.
- Search is upstream-first. One-edit typo matching only ranks fetched candidates; it does not guarantee typo recall and makes no additional request.
- Preview screenshot caching is not implemented.
- Award indexing is explicit, bounded, polite, and does not run at startup. URL guards block private/loopback/metadata destinations by default; use `allowLocal` only for trusted local development.
